# Buildings and tiles

66 placeable things in 12 categories. `unlock` is the population (peak) at which the Build menu offers it. Costs are coins; `upkeep` is coins per second before the town-size and policy multipliers (see [Economy](economy.md)).

How to read an entry: **Radius** is the service reach in tiles (Manhattan diamond); **Provides** lists the city-stat coverage it adds (see [City stats](stats.md)); **Output** is the network supply it adds (power, water, sewage units); **Jobs** is staff; **Pollution** is `[radius, strength]`; **Tourism** is visitor income strength; **Visited** means citizens walk there as a leisure destination; **Grant** is a free income (coins per second, scaled by `RATE`).

### Road

The backbone of your city. Every building needs a road on one of its four sides, or it sits idle with a red mark. Citizens walk only along roads, so your layout decides how long commutes are.

| | |

| Id | `ROAD` |
| Cost / upkeep | 5 / 0.08 per s |
| Unlocks at | 0 population |
| Kind | road |
| Map colour / letter | `#4d4d4a` / `-` |

*Tip:* Build loops and grids. Dead ends mean long walks and grumpy residents.

### Avenue

A wide, fast road. Works like a normal road for connecting buildings, but citizens walk 50% faster along it and path-finding prefers it.

| | |
|---|---|
| Id | `AVENUE` |
| Cost / upkeep | 12 / 0.2 per s |
| Unlocks at | 25 population |
| Kind | road |
| Map colour / letter | `#5c5c5a` / `-` |

*Tip:* Run an avenue through the middle of long commutes, then fill the sides with zones.

### Power line

Carries electricity. Power plants feed any connected line; a building is powered when a live line touches one of its four sides or its own tile. Lines can run under roads and buildings. Each unit of demand beyond plant output causes brownouts for everyone on the grid.

| | |

| Id | `WIRE` |
| Cost / upkeep | 2 / 0.03 per s |
| Unlocks at | 15 population |
| Kind | net |
| Network layer | wire |
| Map colour / letter | `#e0c050` / `-` |

*Tip:* Run lines along roads. Auto-growth lays them for you, but you can draw your own and bulldoze twice to cut one.

### Water pipe

Carries water from towers to buildings, same rules as power lines. Total demand above the pumps' output lowers water pressure for the whole network. Burst mains and droughts hit it hard.

| Cost / upkeep | 2 / 0.03 per s |
| Unlocks at | 15 population |
| Kind | net |
| Network layer | pipe |
| Map colour / letter | `#5aa0d0` / `-` |

*Tip:* Water towers must touch a connected pipe to pump anything.

Treats 16 units of sewage from the sewer network. It smells, so keep it a few tiles from homes. Untreated demand overloads every connected building.
